source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.quote: Real Sociedad Baghdadi Capital Financial services
source.note: Shirt-sponsor table row. Corroborated by the club's own shop photos of the 2026/27 home shirt (rsstore.realsociedad.eus, product kamiseta-home-2627), which show Baghdadi Capital across the front.

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.quote: Kutxabank sponsors the back of Basque clubs Alavés and Real Sociedad, while already being a front-of-shirt sponsor for Basque rival Athletic.

source.name: Joma Sport, Primera equipación Real Sociedad Joma (club announcement)
source.quote: Fuimos, somos y seremos. La nueva camiseta txuri urdin abre la etapa entre el club y Joma con un diseño fiel a las rayas tradicionales y tecnología aplicada al rendimiento.
source.note: Kit maker (recorded as partner per existing convention). Joma's own announcement of the first 2026/27 Real Sociedad shirt; the same article states Joma became the club's official technical sponsor from July, replacing Macron.

summary: Baghdadi Capital on the front, Kutxabank on the back, no sleeve sponsor (one of five La Liga clubs without one), Joma as kit maker.
